data.gender_notes: Armitage is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin arma, meaning ‘arms’ or ‘military equipment’. Derived from the Old French armes, meaning ‘armed’. Armitage is a name of power and strength, often given to a child destined for a leadership role. The name Armitage carries the meaning “Powerful, mighty” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Armitage usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, mighty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
